descriptionCaption: The description is this skill's interface — it is the only thing an agent reads when deciding whether to apply the skill. Write it directively, starting with the trigger: "Use when reviewing database migrations…".

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Import a skill from a file, a URL, or the community catalog.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill from the list on the left to open its editor.

detail.deleteConfirm: Delete the skill "{name}"? Its versions and eval cases go with it.

drawer.title: Add a skill
drawer.subtitle: Import from a file, a URL, or search vetted community skills

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.descriptionPlaceholder: What this skill teaches the reviewer
file.bodyHint: Pasted content is wrapped as untrusted data — never executed as instructions.

import.title: Import a skill
import.subtitle: From a Markdown file or an archive — nothing is stored until you confirm
import.fileHint: A Markdown file (.md, .markdown) or a .zip archive. Only Markdown entries are read; nothing in an archive is executed.
import.unsupported: Unsupported file — pick a .md, .markdown or .zip file.
import.previewFailed: Could not extract a skill from that file.
import.previewHint: Nothing has been saved yet. Check what was extracted, then confirm.
import.skippedNote: These entries are not Markdown, so the product neither read nor executed them — nothing in them can reach the skill body.
import.emptyBody: The file produced an empty body.
import.success: Imported "{name}" — disabled until you vet and enable it.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched server-side, stored as untrusted, and left disabled until vetted.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from an untrusted source. Its body is stored as data (delimiter-wrapped) and must be vetted before it is enabled for an agent.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.
preview.renderedHint: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it — the text below is injected into the review prompt as data.
preview.emptyBody: This skill has an empty body.

noRepo.title: No repository selected
noRepo.body: Pick a repository to browse and attach its context documents.

unsavedDialog.title: Discard unsaved changes?
unsavedDialog.body: Switching to another skill will discard the changes you made to this one's configuration.

config.title: Configuration
config.descriptionPlaceholder: What this skill teaches the reviewer
config.savedToast: Saved — this skill is now v{version}.

evals.title: Eval cases
evals.subtitle: Replay a diff through this skill and check the findings it produces.

empty.title: No eval cases yet
empty.body: Add a case with a diff and the findings you expect, then run it to check the skill still holds.

evals.noProviderKey: No LLM provider key is configured, so eval runs are disabled. Add a key in Settings → API Keys and try again.
evals.deleteConfirm: Delete the eval case "{name}"? This cannot be undone.

modal.subtitle: A diff in, the findings you expect out.
modal.diffHint: Unified diff, exactly as the reviewer would receive it.
modal.expectedHint: How many findings this diff should produce.

stats.agentsEmpty: No agent has this skill linked yet.
stats.categoryEmpty: No findings recorded in the last 30 days.
stats.attributionNote: Attribution is run-level: these are findings from runs that included this skill, not findings traced to it.

versions.title: Version history
versions.subtitle: Every body edit mints an immutable version. Compare two, or restore one.

empty.title: No version history
empty.body: Editing the body on the Config tab creates the first version.

versions.pickTwo: Pick two different versions to see what changed.
versions.identical: These two versions have identical bodies.
versions.restoreConfirm: Restore v{version}? Its body becomes the current body as a new version.
versions.restoreToast: Restored v{version} — this skill is now v{current}.
